## Progress

- Merged [PR #5](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/5) (MUI) then [PR #29](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/29) (shadcn/ui + Radix + Tailwind 4, ADR-010): tokens in styles.css, clinical primitives, UI gallery at /__ui
- WCAG fixes found by tests: primary #0F766E (was 3.8:1), success-on-tint #07774F (was 4.42:1); browser axe 0 violations in English and Arabic

## Description

packages/ui is the design system (ADR-010): shadcn/ui components (Radix) and Tailwind 4 tokens from Foundations/Handoff (`styles.css`), plus the clinical primitives: Button states (default/hover/focus/loading/disabled with count), StatusChip (ordered/received/reviewed/completed, icon + label), ProvenanceTag (AI draft · not reviewed dashed violet / Verified / Synced from HIS / Patient reported / Imported / Signed), Alert (critical/attention/info with words), TextField states, RecordingPill (REC/paused/declined), IdentityBanner (name, age, sex, MRN, DOB, allergies never collapsed, consent, encounter, SYNTHETIC marker). A storybook-like gallery page in web/clinic (/__ui) shows every state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Tokens in packages/ui/src/styles.css (palette, Manrope/JetBrains Mono, radius 10, breakpoints 360/768/1280/1600) match docs/02-design/tokens.md, with WCAG deviations listed in docs/02-design/README.md; buttons are ≥ 44px, bold, not uppercase; cards have a 1px #DFE7ED border and no shadow.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every primitive renders all states listed in Handoff §1; no status is conveyed by colour alone (icon + text present, checked by test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Focus ring is 2px #2563EB with 2px offset on all interactive primitives.
- [ ] **AC4.** axe reports no violations on the gallery page; text contrast of tokens matches the Foundations ratios (≥ 4.5:1 for text).
- [ ] **AC5.** prefers-reduced-motion disables animation in RecordingPill/progress.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
